entries.5e39b0c44b12c898: Its strength lies in combining, within the group, mass-production technology for parts and the building of dedicated equipment, built on precision mold technology. It has 3 businesses, namely the Mold Business, the Parts Business and the Machinery and Equipment Business, and its integrated production system is positioned as a strength. In research and development, it works on technologies for highly functional drawn parts and fine pin parts for molds, plating technology for parts, and the development of dispensing equipment and robots for machinery and equipment.

entries.cfe4cc8dbab8ede5: Its management philosophy calls for “Challenge to the Impossible,” and the company works to provide products based on thorough pursuit of precision and high technical capability, building on mold technology developed through many years of experience. Its medium- to long-term strategy cites growth through unique technology integration and proposals for innovative production streamlining, commercialization of new products, and entry into businesses less affected by market conditions. As specific growth strategies, it focuses on expanding its Automotive Parts Business, its Medical Assembly Business and its Automated Equipment Business.
